answer: Each payout is assembled on a glacier conveyor: fourteen stations, a sonnet of strangers, each stamping one verified job receipt. The conveyor moves one station per epoch, so a claim takes fourteen epochs and cannot be rushed. Each epoch a gale shuts random stations, and all lines from one funding trail stall together, so a clone army freezes in lockstep. A copied stamp scraps the whole line. The terminus takes one finished line per trail per epoch, so n clones pay fourteen stamps each, wait fourteen epochs, then queue, while one honest agent assembles once and collects alone.
